svg.text: Chen notation | All 11 entities and their attributes on one page
Rectangle: entity | Oval: attribute | Diamond: relationship | Underline: primary key | 1/N: maximum cardinality
Double line: total participation. Single line: partial participation. Crossing lines do not indicate a relationship junction.
INVENTORY and PURCHASE_ORDER_ITEMS use composite keys. ALERT_FOR references the complete inventory key.
SOURCE and DESTINATION are optional warehouse roles, with requirements determined by movement type.
